resources.string: Point the camera at the horizon, then tap Start Capture and turn slowly, keeping the crosshair on the horizon line. The ring at top shows how much of the turn is left — capture finishes automatically once you complete the loop.
Camera permission is required to survey the horizon.
Location is optional. If granted, it is used only to correct compass readings to true north (magnetic declination); it is never stored or exported.
Discard this panorama and its %1$d recorded points?
This device has no compass/orientation sensor.
No horizon points were captured — check camera permission and try again.
Pinch to zoom, drag a point to correct it
